Ta'amti Bourekas (Frozen)

Ingredients:
2 frozen Ta'amti bourekas (cheese)

Instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 375°F.
2. Place the frozen bourekas on a parchment-lined baking sheet, seam side down.
3. Bake 25-30 minutes, until puffed and deep golden brown.
4. Cool a few minutes before eating — the filling is very hot.
note: Store-bought frozen staple, 1 serving = 2 bourekas.
